decisions.reason: The black-finish range sits close to the core offer, costs little to carry as a finish variant, and its rising website presence (its own page in 2024) shows the option is still developing rather than resolved negatively.
The shower channel for seamless coverings has held its own page across both years and fits the barrier-free bathroom strategy, so its option value remains high and its carrying cost low.
Launched only in 2024, the pump-drain channel's value is still uncertain, and it likely succeeds the withdrawn pump-assisted line C, so the firm keeps this option open while its prospects resolve.
